# Chandan Shakya — Portfolio & Blog

> Full Stack Web Developer from Kathmandu, Nepal. Linux enthusiast with a decade of tinkering experience.

## About
Personal portfolio showcasing projects, blog posts, and technical writing. Built with Astro (static output), hand-written CSS with a brutalist text-first design. No Tailwind, no client JS framework.

## Key Sections
- [Projects](https://chandanshakya.com.np/projects) — 27 projects across Laravel, Python, Docker, and more
- [Blog](https://chandanshakya.com.np/blog) — 10 technical articles on Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and web development
- [Archive](https://chandanshakya.com.np/archive) — Complete timeline of all content
